g.text: Allow collection of anonymous usage data?
Toad can collect basic usage data (number of
installs, OS version, agents used, session length
etc). This information is associated with a
randomly generated UUID (see it in /about:toad) and
Collecting this information will help me (Will
McGugan) convince big tech to take this project
seriously. I would appreciate if you left this on,
but it is entirely up to you.
